Sports Premium
What is the Primary PE and Sport Premium?
The PE and Sport Premium is designed to help primary schools improve the quality of the PE and sport activities they offer their pupils. The funding is ring-fenced and therefore can only be spent on provision of PE and sport in schools.

Carisbrooke CE Primary School
PSHE & RHE
Personal, Social, Health Education
Relationships & Health Education
successful learners - confident individuals - responsible citizens
At Carisbrooke CE, we teach Personal, Social, Health Education and Relationships & Health as part of a whole school approach to underpin children's development as people because we believe that this also supports their learning capacity.
STATUTORY RELATIONSHIPS & HEALTH EDUCATION
We include the statutory Relationships and Health Education within our whole-school PSHE/RHE Programme.
“Parents have the right to request that their child be withdrawn from some or all of sex education delivered as part of statutory Relationships and Sex Education” DfE Guidance p.17
At Carisbrooke CE School, puberty is taught as a statutory requirement of Health Education and covered by our SCARF Programme as part of the 'Growing and Changing' unit. We conclude that sex education refers to human reporduction, and therefore inform parents of their right to request their child be withdrawn from the PSHE lessons that explicity teach this:
Year 6 - making babies lesson
CLICK HERE for further information about the 'Growing & Changing' unit.

Carisbrooke CE Primary School
RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
successful learners - confident individuals - responsible citizens
Through the study of RE, we aim to develop the children's understanding and appreciation of different beliefs, practices and religions within the modern world. We encourage the children to be confident, informed individuals who are capable of responding approriately to situations and circumstances, and be tolerant and respectful towards other peoples' values and beliefs. We aim to inspire the children to explore and challenge their own personal views and beliefs, and to celebrate their differences. Thus, developing the children culturally, morally, spiritually and socially.

pageCache.pageTitle: Pupil Premium | Carisbrooke CE Primary School
pageCache.text:
Carisbrooke CE Primary School
Pupil Premium
The pupil premium is an allocation of additional funding provided to schools to support specific groups of children who are vulnerable to possible underachievement. These include pupils who are entitled to Free School meals; those looked after by the Local Authority and the children of armed service personnel.
All schools are required to account for the amount of funding received and how it has been used to support these groups of pupils. Once information is available, the impact of the funding should also be reported.
